# Hearth & Grain

> Interior design studio creating warm, timeless homes with natural materials. This site is a portfolio demo.

## Pages

- [Home](https://hearth-and-grain.vercel.app/): Studio overview and featured work
- [About](https://hearth-and-grain.vercel.app/about): The studio story, values and team
- [Services](https://hearth-and-grain.vercel.app/services): Full-home, single-room, sourcing and outdoor design
- [Projects](https://hearth-and-grain.vercel.app/projects): Selected residential projects
- [Contact](https://hearth-and-grain.vercel.app/contact): Start a project
